visual_language.direction: warm handmade paper collage slide, tactile paper craft, gentle human-centered storytelling, cozy scrapbook composition

capacity_factor.note: 中性折减：手工质感由材质纹理承担，不占文本区

content_review.reviewer_note: 部分完整（约束=True，密度映射=False，HEX 锚 12）：保持 draft，缺口已记录不猜值

legacy_payload.best_for: 教育、公益、文化、成长、社区和需要温度感的主题演示
legacy_payload.visual_direction: warm handmade paper collage slide, tactile paper craft, gentle human-centered storytelling, cozy scrapbook composition

canvas.background: warm cream paper #F5F1E8 or pale wood #E8DCC8 with subtle paper fibers
canvas.composition: paper cutout title area, 3 paper note cards for key points, gentle illustration accents
canvas.density: airy and comforting, generous breathing room

color_palette.primary: warm brown #A67C52 and deep cocoa #5C4033 for text
color_palette.soft_colors: dusty pink #F5C4B8, sage green #B8D4A8, sky blue #A8D8EA, sunset orange #FFA574, lavender #C9B1D0
color_palette.surface: cream, handmade paper, kraft paper, pastel sticky notes
color_palette.rule: all colors should feel soft, matte, and paper-like
color_palette.accent: terracotta #C97B5A for hand-drawn underlines and stitches

typography.title: rounded handwritten or friendly display style
typography.body: clear friendly handwritten or rounded sans-serif Chinese text
typography.emphasis: paper labels, stitched tags, small handwritten captions
typography.text_quality: Chinese text must be accurate and legible
typography.labels: rounded friendly labels (站酷圆体 / Nunito), small stitches and dots as bullets

layout_patterns: three torn-paper cards aligned naturally across the slide
scrapbook title ribbon with small illustrated stickers
central handmade diagram with taped labels
soft paper collage with one warm illustration and supporting notes
legacy_payload.layout_usage_rule: Use layout_blueprints as candidate starting points only. Choose and adapt the composition according to each slide's semantic role; avoid repeating the same blueprint on adjacent slides unless it is a deliberate repeated sequence.

labels: warm illustration or paper collage scene

visual_elements.allowed: paper texture, torn edges, tape, paper clips, buttons, watercolor blocks, simple doodles, plant stickers, soft shadows
visual_elements.avoid: glossy plastic look, corporate sharp edges, harsh black text, neon colors, overly childish clutter

rendering_constraints: The slide should feel handmade but still presentation-ready.
Paper shadows and textures should be subtle and not reduce text legibility.
No watermark, no unrelated logo, no slide number unless explicitly requested.
